Control / Feature: Just Love Coy Pond — Non-Negotiable Targets
Founder / Controlled Requirement: pH 6.5–8.5; ammonia 0 target; nitrite 0; nitrate target <20 mg/L above source-water baseline where practicable; KH planning floor ~100 mg/L; DO design ≥6 mg/L with higher normal reserve preferred; emergency aeration near 4 mg/L; conservative AMW planning baseline ~500 gal/1,900 L usable fish-water per mature koi plus additional volume for companions.
Control Note: Usable fish-water volume excludes shelves, rocks, bridge footings, protected growing beds, Seal structures and displaced/non-swimming volume.

Control / Feature: Just Love Coy Pond — Near-Self-Cleaning Architecture
Founder / Controlled Requirement: Gravity-assisted bottom drains + surface skimmers + automatic microscreen/rotary-drum solids removal + biological filtration + protected planted polishing/regeneration beds + continuous aeration/degassing + UV where needed + automated purge/backwash + sensors + backup power/aeration + isolation/quarantine capacity.
Control Note: No pond is represented as maintenance-free; the objective is continuous waste export and minimized manual disturbance.
